notes: Self-contained Three.js/TSL WebGPU RPG sample with no WebGL or C++ gameplay path.
All visible UI is rendered through the WebGPU canvas; HTML only bootstraps the module graph.
The optional native reflection bridge registers immutable world geometry only and falls back cleanly to standard WebGPU.
Dynamic actors, vegetation, weather particles, fire effects and transparent water remain on the authored raster/TSL path.
